copy_ready_message: Could you review my Data Quality Agent as an AI Engineer project? The short path now includes the LLM value comparison that shows adaptive strategy selection beating a fixed checklist across 14 scenarios. Public review form: https://sunnnn2005.github.io/data-quality-agent/first-ai-reviewer-ask.html
counting_boundary: This page can support the first AI Engineer review only after a real non-owner reviewer submits a public, redacted GitHub issue with permission to count. A sent message or page view does not count.

inspection_targets.label: Agent loop and tool routing
inspection_targets.question: Does the LLM choose tools based on evidence instead of following a fixed script?

inspection_targets.label: Safety boundaries
inspection_targets.question: Are read-only data access, query limits, and redaction rules clear enough?

inspection_targets.label: Evidence-backed reporting
inspection_targets.question: Are facts, inferences, limitations, and resume-safe claims separated?

inspection_targets.label: Adaptive strategy value
inspection_targets.question: Does the 14-scenario comparison make the agentic strategy selection more credible than a fixed workflow?

inspection_targets.label: Real model evidence gate
inspection_targets.question: Would the telemetry be enough to verify a real OpenAI-compatible run later?

permission_sentence: I give permission for this public issue to be counted as project review evidence.
purpose: Give the first AI/ML systems reviewer one focused public page for inspecting the agent design and submitting countable review evidence without exposing private data.
recommended_reviewer: AI engineer, mentor, or ML systems reviewer
record_sent_command: python scripts/record_reviewer_outreach_event.py --slot-id review_slot_07 --status sent --reviewer-contact "<reviewer name or handle>" --channel-used "LinkedIn DM or mentor email" --note "Sent first AI Engineer reviewer request"
required_public_evidence: reviewer is not the repository owner
at least one inspected file, page, command, or behavior is named
one concrete AI-agent strength or gap is described
I give permission for this public issue to be counted as project review evidence.
no private data, secrets, customer records, private emails, addresses, API keys, or production rows
resume_safe_summary: Published a focused first AI reviewer ask page with 5 inspection targets, 4 review questions, LLM value-comparison evidence, permission language, and recording guidance while keeping accepted AI reviews at zero.
review_questions: What is the strongest AI Engineer signal in this project?
What is the least credible or most missing part of the agent design?
Which file or behavior should be improved before this is resume-strong?
Would you count this as an LLM agent project, and why?
